correctness.rationale: Couple opposite focal types by including each other's focal player together, with probability (n-1)/(N-1), and otherwise sampling the same n-1 common candidates. In the inclusion case the public benefits cancel, leaving the unit cost; otherwise the benefit difference is the hypergeometric average of a_{J+1}-a_J. This yields Eq. (1) and degree at most n-1. The two endpoint cases J=0 and J=n-1, with positive strictly increasing returns reaching r(n)=n(N-1)/(N-n), give Δ_1<0<Δ_{N-1}. Sign changes between consecutive nonzero entries force roots in disjoint open intervals and their total is odd. At N=n+1 the conditional sample is deterministic and the given rational schedule gives Δ_i=d_i. Its partial sums S_k for k<n stay between -ε and -ε/2, so all multipliers are positive. The strict increase follows from d_k>S_{k-1}/(k-1) for k≥2: positive d_k are immediate and each negative middle entry is controlled by 2^k>2(k-1). The n=2 empty middle range works; for odd n the final positive entry repeats the preceding sign, giving n-2, and for even n it completes alternation. In the symmetric Fermi chain the fixation ratio is exp(βΣΔ_i), so the zero sum implies exact equality for all β and half occupation in the stated rare-symmetric-mutation limit. In fact summing (1) via Σ_i binom(i-1,j)binom(N-i-1,n-1-j)=binom(N-1,n) gives ΣΔ_i=(N-n)r(n)/n-(N-1), so neutrality is true for all admissible schedules. Independently tabulated the direct focal payoffs for the construction at n=2–20 with exact fractions, including terminal-sum and degree spot checks; inspected the supplied checker without executing it. All integer validity is analytic; sharpness is not asserted for every fixed larger N.

value.rationale: The result identifies the exact largest local sign complexity compatible with a natural global neutrality criterion and strictly increasing returns. The witnesses show that strict economies of scale permit the maximum number of reversals rather than merely one threshold, even though the absorbing-state comparison is unchanged. This is a complete all-group-size extremum with a feasible witness, not a claim of empirically common schedules or of oscillatory individual trajectories.
